about_the_game:
Build the Drifting Sanctuary

The core gameplay for Dryad revolves around the construction of your home island. Expander Seeds exist to repair and grow your homestead. Push your creativity to its limit with your island design. Will it weather the upcoming challenges?

Overcome Environmental Problems

Each level brings with it new enemies alongside a reigning boss. Each encounter offers a unique challenge that will test your adaptability, management skills, and your island's design.

Fend off Invaders

Dryad is not a passive game. Enemies are ceaseless between zones and will seek to harass you at any opportunity they get. Jump straight into the action as the Wisp and take control of combat. Bash enemies, move plants, heal tiles, harvest energy, and much more!

Explore the World

See the world of Dryad. In between all the action. The full experience will include 10 Chapters with handcrafted levels, each designed with a meaningful theme and unique challenge.
